note: No class is active yet. A class becomes usable only when a named human reviewer has checked its label and handshape against an official reference below and set verified to true with the reference filled in. Do not add classes from memory or from unofficial sites.

class_schema.label: Short English gloss or letter used as the class name (for example A or the gloss in the reference)
class_schema.hands: 1 or 2, matching the handshape in the reference
class_schema.meaning: What the sign means in the reference
class_schema.reference: Source id from sources plus the page, video, or entry used
class_schema.verified: true only after a human has checked the sign against the reference

sources.name: ISL Dictionary, Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC), DEPwD, MoSJE
sources.checked: search excerpt only (PIB release 17 Feb 2021: 10,000 terms, videos by Deaf signers, validated in national workshops)

sources.name: Indian Sign Language, National Institute of Open Schooling
sources.notes: States that ISL fingerspelling is two-handed in the common form, and that ISL is not a manual form of English. Do not treat ASL or BSL letter shapes as ISL without checking.

sources.name: Diploma in Teaching Indian Sign Language (DTISL) curriculum, Rehabilitation Council of India
sources.notes: Lists the English manual alphabet as two-handed for basic communication and one-handed for deaf-blind learners.
